description: Synthetic evaluation set for evidence-grounded case Q&A. All organizations, people, domains (.example) and addresses (RFC 5737 documentation ranges) are invented. Version 3 keeps every version 2 case, evidence record and question unchanged. The eight version 2 holdout questions are relabelled 'regression': they have been inspected and are now guarded against, not held out. A third case adds held-out questions (split 'holdout') for subject applicability, time scope, conflict disclosure and change over time, written and frozen before the run that reports them and not used to tune prompts, retrieval or validation.
